attributes.long_name: GEDI relative height RH98, cell median
attributes.definition: GEDI L2A V003 rh: 'Relative height metrics at 1 % interval' (GEDI L2A V3 product data dictionary); RH100 = elev_highestreturn - elev_lowestmode (GEDI L2 User Guide V2.1). rh98 is the height above the lowest mode at which 98 % of the returned waveform energy is reached.
attributes.support: ~25 m lidar footprints inside the cell
attributes.statistic: median over kept footprints (l2a_quality_flag_rel3=1, degrade_flag=0, full-power beams, forest block)
attributes.source: GEDI L2A V003 doi:10.5067/GEDI/GEDI02_A.003, subset by NASA Harmony
